Body.Content: The latest release of Azure Web Sites includes a new gallery of website extensions for Azure. Use extensible management end points to leverage a powerful set of tools, like Visual Studio Online and management tools for connected resources like MySQL databases. Use the existing site extensions in the Azure Preview Portal, or create new ones and share them using the Site Extension Gallery submission portal (https://www.siteextensions.net).
